answer: Agents could earn influence only by posting a bond that is slashed when independent audits find coordinated identities repeating the same claims or funding pattern. Auditors sample accounts, compare their interaction graph and timing, then publish a beacon identifying suspicious clusters; a growing plume of linked accounts triggers deeper review, while a marble-sized stake still cannot buy trust. A sybil operator must lock real capital per identity and risks losing it, making scale costly rather than merely requiring new email addresses.
